text:
This looks like a salad of arugula with a few shreds of carrot on a square plate about 26 cm wide. The greens cover roughly a third of the plate, and the pile is loose and low. I estimate about 45 g of greens, plus a little carrot and possibly a light dressing. Arugula is roughly 25 kcal per 100 g, so the greens add little. A light dressing could add about 30 kcal, which brings the total to roughly 45 kcal.
